description: This file defines the CRPage class and related classes for managing Chromium pages within Playwright, including frame and session management, event handling, navigation, and emulation features.

classes.name: CRPage
classes.description: Represents a Chromium page in Playwright, managing frames, sessions, navigation, and emulation.

classes.name: FrameSession
classes.description: Manages a session for a specific frame, handling events, navigation, and context.

methods.name: mainFrameSession
methods.description: Returns the main frame session for a given page.

methods.name: _forAllFrameSessions
methods.description: Executes a callback for all frame sessions.

methods.name: _sessionForFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the session associated with a specific frame.

methods.name: _sessionForHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the session associated with a DOM element handle.

methods.name: willBeginDownload
methods.description: Handles the start of a download.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page is closed.

methods.name: navigateFrame
methods.description: Navigates a frame to a specified URL.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Updates the extra HTTP headers for the page.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the page to the front.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds a script to be evaluated on new document.

methods.name: exposePlaywrightBinding
methods.description: Exposes Playwright binding to the page.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the page.

methods.name: getContentFrame
methods.description: Gets the content frame of an element.

methods.name: getOwnerFrame
methods.description: Gets the owner frame of an element.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Gets the bounding box of an element.

methods.name: scrollRectIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls a rect into view if needed.

methods.name: rafCountForStablePosition
methods.description: Returns the frame count for stable position.

methods.name: getContentQuads
methods.description: Gets content quads of an element.

methods.name: adoptElementHandle
methods.description: Adopts an element handle into a different context.

methods.name: pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the page.

methods.name: getFrameElement
methods.description: Gets the frame element for a frame.

methods.name: shouldToggleStyleSheetToSyncAnimations
methods.description: Indicates if style sheet toggling is needed for sync animations.
